messages:
Riley (CS): FYI - SableFleet shows a ~62% drop in seat pings and ~58% drop in API calls over the past 12 days. New procurement lead (Derek Shaw) started this week; CTO said they're running a short bake-off with NeuroServe. Renewal ~40 days out. Can we triage?

Anika (Solutions): on it. Pulling logs now  any webhook/auth spikes? looping in @Mina.

Mina (Eng): seeing clustered 401/429 for org_id=44100 on 2025-07-11. Proxy samples: `{"org":"44100","status":401,"path":"/v1/chat","err":"invalid_token"}` and `{"org":"44100","status":429,"path":"/v1/embeddings","err":"rate_limit"}`. Also delivery failures on billing webhook (410).

Anika (Solutions): 410 on billing webhook can flip account features  that could drop seat activity. Can we confirm webhook endpoint + secret?

Webhook Bot: Support ticket SF-9002 opened  "SableFleet: invalid_token + billing webhook 410" https://support.redwood/sf/9002

Hector (Sales): Renewal window short. If Derek is testing NeuroServe we need to (1) restore operations fast, (2) offer a short perf/demo window to stall momentum. I'll prep commercial terms.

Riley (CS): Proposed immediate playbook:
- Outreach: quick async note to Derek offering a 30-min triage call today (Anika + Mina).
- Tech: confirm API token in env matches console; Mina to rotate token and retry webhook deliveries.
- Commercial: offer a 14-day dedicated perf burst (complimentary) + telemetry review; Hector to draft PO.
- Exec: schedule a short QBR/demo for CTO showing routing/fallbacks; I'll book.

Mina (Eng): I can rotate the token and re-send webhook attempts. ETA ~25m. Will add a temporary rate-limit window to reduce retry storms.

Anika (Solutions): Drafting message to Derek with quick checklist: (1) confirm token value in env matches dashboard, (2) upgrade SDK >=1.5.2, (3) run one sample request below and paste response.

Hector (Sales): Draft PO language: "14-day dedicated perf window, SLA 99.9%, telemetry review, complimentary credits". Routing to Legal for fast-track.

Riley (CS): Tagging CRM reasons: ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_bakeoff"] and marking renewal_flag=at-risk until QBR. Please update when SF-9002 is resolved and when QBR is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
